what_the_claim_asserts: The finding this register exists to state: NO claim currently at VERIFIED in this repository changes status if Arnold's strata are shown to be unreliable.
how_it_depends_on_arnold: Every VERIFIED claim that touches the strata is a COUNT OF THE CODES. A count of how many padas carry the letter P is true whatever the letter P means. Only claims that read a code as a date are exposed, and every one of those was already capped at PROVISIONAL or HYPOTHESIS when it was written.
status_if_arnold_is_shown_unreliable: No status change anywhere at VERIFIED.
what_changes_instead: What changes is not status but USE. Fifteen VERIFIED rows would keep their truth and lose their point: they would measure a classification that classifies nothing. The register's chronological capacity, not its accuracy, is what is at risk.
notes: This is the answer to the question the unit was commissioned with, and it is a better answer than a list of downgrades would have been, because it means the earlier units already drew the line in the right place. It is also a weaker position than it sounds: a register full of true counts of a meaningless label is not a chronology.

what_the_claim_asserts: Arnold's stratum letters are A Archaic, S Strophic, N Normal, C Cretic, P Popular, and small italics mean the period is indicated by metrical variations alone.
how_it_depends_on_arnold: This is a claim ABOUT Arnold's text, sourced to SRC-026, the archive.org OCR of Arnold 1905 Appendix IV section 265 at printed p. 269, retrieved 2026-09-07T00:50Z.
status_if_arnold_is_shown_unreliable: UNCHANGED - stays VERIFIED
what_changes_instead: Nothing. If Arnold's periods were shown to be worthless, it would remain true that those are the letters he used and what he said they meant.
notes: Checked in this unit because it is the only VERIFIED claim whose sole source is Arnold himself. The retrieval event behind it is real. SRC-083 initially recorded Arnold as unread here; that was wrong and has been corrected in the ledger.
